color.note: One look: graph paper on a dark stage, with a dark studio deck docked at the bottom. Values are the episode's own; contrast figures are WCAG 2 ratios.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, numbers and every outline (1.1px on machines, 1.2px on cards). Also the fill of default pills, the terminal and the data-grid header row. 15.0:1 on cream, 16.2:1 on paper, 13.8:1 on node.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary words: eyebrows, captions, counters, scene titles, axis words. 4.8:1 on paper, 5.1:1 on white. On cream it reads 4.4:1 and on node 4.1:1, just under the 4.5:1 floor. That is the episode's own pairing, kept: use muted there for short labels only and set anything a reader must study in ink.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Data and code: the header rule, flow lines, the bit ribbon, code pills, filter and select pills, links, network activity, key k1. As text 5.5:1 on cream, 5.9:1 on paper; cream text on it 5.5:1.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Healthy, done and kept: LEDs, checked steps, the progress fill, kept rows, success pills, Do this, real-work bars, key k2. 4.6:1 against cream either way round.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Cost and failure: stalled and queued pills, straggler LEDs, overhead blocks, the barrier, cost figures, dropped rows, anti-patterns. Never a key color. 5.2:1 against cream either way round.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Now: the blinking cursor, the word being spoken, the current step, disk and hourglass activity, the scrubber, link hover, waiting LEDs, broadcast, key k3. A mark color on light grounds (2.8:1 on cream, so never amber text there). As text it lives on the deck: 5.4:1 on ink.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: The page: the frame's graph-paper ground and the deck's 3.5px border. Also the text on ink, blue, green and red fills (on-ink, on-blue, on-green and on-red point here).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Raised cards on the ground: the cost card, metric cards, the closing card, outline pills.

tokens.name: node
tokens.usage: Machine fill: executors, reducers and stage boxes. It is the front face; the top face is 25% lighter and the side face 22% darker.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Record cards, the progress-bar track, data-grid cells, and labels on blue, green, red and key-4 slabs (6.3:1, 5.3:1, 5.9:1, 11.3:1).

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: The dark backdrop around the frame. Nothing sits on it except the frame.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on ink fills: default pills, terminal text, the data-grid header row. 15.0:1.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text on blue fills such as filter and select pills. 5.5:1. The spoken code pill uses white (6.3:1).

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text on green fills such as success pills. 4.6:1.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text on red fills: stalled, barrier and overhead pills. 5.2:1.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text on amber fills: 5.4:1. The episode set its one amber pill in cream (2.8:1); this system sets amber pills and amber slab labels in ink.

tokens.name: key-1
tokens.usage: Partition key k1. Keys are always assigned in order k1 to k4, as slab fills and key pills.

tokens.name: key-2
tokens.usage: Partition key k2.

tokens.name: key-3
tokens.usage: Partition key k3. Label slabs of this key in ink.

tokens.name: key-4
tokens.usage: Partition key k4, a warm umber. White labels read 11.3:1 on it.

tokens.name: deck-bg
tokens.usage: The studio deck behind the script and its controls.

tokens.name: deck-text
tokens.usage: Spoken words and button labels on deck-bg. 15.0:1.

tokens.name: deck-muted
tokens.usage: The deck's top line (clock and counters) on deck-bg. 4.8:1.

tokens.name: deck-unspoken
tokens.usage: Words not yet spoken, on deck-bg. 2.3:1, dim on purpose: each word brightens to deck-text as it is spoken. Never use it for text that stays.

tokens.name: deck-line
tokens.usage: Deck button borders on deck-bg. 1.5:1, the episode's own value: the label carries the button, and hover turns the border amber.

tokens.name: deck-tick
tokens.usage: Scene ticks on the scrubber, on deck-bg. 2.5:1, the episode's own value. Beat ticks are amber.

tokens.name: deck-code
tokens.usage: Code-pill text in the script. 7.1:1 on deck-code-bg over deck-bg.

tokens.name: deck-code-bg
tokens.usage: Code-pill fill in the script (blue at 18%).

tokens.name: deck-code-line
tokens.usage: Code-pill border in the script (blue at 60%).

tokens.name: deck-on
tokens.usage: A toggled-on deck button's label; its border turns green. 9.3:1 on deck-bg.

tokens.name: deck-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on the deck. 5.4:1 on deck-bg. An addition: the episode had no focus style.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on cream and paper. 5.5:1 on cream. An addition: the episode had no focus style.

tokens.name: grid-major
tokens.usage: Graph-paper lines every 70px (pitch-major) on cream.

tokens.name: grid-minor
tokens.usage: Graph-paper lines every 14px (pitch-minor) on cream.

tokens.name: vignette
tokens.usage: Edge darkening of the frame: a radial fade from clear at 55% to this at 100%.

tokens.name: header-bg
tokens.usage: The header bar, translucent cream over the canvas.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers between label and value rows on cards.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Isometric rack tiles (top face; left face 16% darker, right face 30% darker) and the lit side of the disk.

tokens.name: tile-shade
tokens.usage: The shaded face of the series mark and the dark edge of the disk.

tokens.name: slab
tokens.usage: A partition slab before it has a key.

tokens.name: platform
tokens.usage: Flat platforms under the grey hatch: the partition pool and the shuffle bridge.

tokens.name: fact
tokens.usage: Slabs of the fact table, the big table that never moves. Label them in ink (8.5:1).

tokens.name: block
tokens.usage: Neutral data blocks in the network pipe, and columns on their way out.

tokens.name: tint-kept
tokens.usage: Rows that survive a filter. Ink text 14.3:1.

tokens.name: tint-dropped
tokens.usage: Rows a filter drops, and a straggler's rack tile. Ink text 13.2:1.

tokens.name: tint-queued
tokens.usage: Blocks stuck in the queue at the network throat.

tokens.name: hatch-grey
tokens.usage: Diagonal hatch for waiting time and platforms (5px step, 0.9px line).

tokens.name: hatch-white
tokens.usage: Diagonal hatch laid over green real-work bars (5px step, 1.4px line).

tokens.name: string
tokens.usage: String literals in the terminal, on ink. 10.1:1.

tokens.name: led-soft
tokens.usage: The LED dot inside a green pill (4.2:1 on green).

groups.name: Chrome
groups.note: The frame's HTML parts. Sizes are at the 470px reference frame; multiply by k = frame width / 470. Everything but the script is uppercase.

styles.name: chrome-header
styles.usage: The header line, uppercase. The right-hand counter takes weight 500, letter-spacing 0.1em, in muted.

styles.name: chrome-meta
styles.usage: The deck's top line, uppercase, in deck-muted; the segment label takes weight 700 in amber.

styles.name: chrome-script
styles.sample: Each record is serialized, compressed, written to local disk, fetched over the network, decompressed, and rebuilt.
styles.usage: The narration in the deck, word by word.

styles.name: chrome-code
styles.usage: Code inside the script, set as a code pill at 0.84em of the script.

groups.name: Statement
groups.note: Newsreader, with optical sizing left on. Only for beats and the end card.

styles.name: closing
styles.usage: The end card's title: the episode's lesson in three or four words. Once per episode.

styles.name: beat
styles.sample: The fix is not a faster pipe.
styles.usage: A beat: one sentence in the expanded deck between scenes.

styles.name: closing-sub
styles.usage: The line under the end card's title, in muted.

groups.name: Canvas
groups.note: Drawn on the scene canvas at the 470px reference width. Each is a single line, so line heights are for HTML use.

styles.name: count-xl
styles.usage: The scene's one big number, centered.

styles.name: count-lg
styles.usage: The figure on a stat card; red when it is a cost.

styles.name: count-md
styles.usage: A counter above a pool, counting down or up.

styles.name: delta
styles.usage: A before-to-after figure, in green when it shrinks.

styles.name: scene-title
styles.usage: Scene number, em dash, scene name, in muted over a dashed rule.

styles.name: canvas-code
styles.usage: The terminal line; code on cards takes weight 600.

styles.name: canvas-value
styles.usage: Values at the right of label and value rows.

styles.name: canvas-caption
styles.usage: Captions under big numbers and the labels of rows.

styles.name: canvas-label
styles.usage: Card eyebrows and pill text, uppercase.

styles.name: canvas-micro
styles.usage: Names under drawn objects (NETWORK, LOCAL DISK, REDUCER 1) and record fields.

spacing.note: The episode's own steps at the 470px frame, named by their pixel value. Layout sits on the 14px graph-paper grid.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Side padding of the script.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between deck buttons; a button's side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap in the header; gap between pills in a row.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: A pill's side padding; a button's top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between the scrubber and the buttons; the script's bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: The deck's inset from the frame edges; gap in the deck's top line.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: The deck's top and bottom padding; the script's top padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: The deck's side padding and a card's inner padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: The header's side padding; the smallest inset of a card from the frame edge.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: The scene title's inset; the beat statement's top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: pitch-minor
tokens.usage: The minor graph-paper pitch. Snap canvas layout to it.

tokens.name: pitch-major
tokens.usage: The major graph-paper pitch (5 minor squares).

radius.note: Each radius belongs to one kind of object.

tokens.name: radius-check
tokens.usage: Step checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Progress bars and task bars.

tokens.name: radius-code
tokens.usage: Code pills and record cards.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Deck buttons.

tokens.name: radius-terminal
tokens.usage: The terminal bar.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-frame
tokens.usage: The frame and the closing card.

tokens.name: radius-deck
tokens.usage: The studio deck.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills: always half their height.

stroke.note: Everything drawn has an ink outline with round joins.

tokens.name: stroke-fine
tokens.usage: Rack tiles, slabs, vents, dividers, data-grid cells, task bars, the scene-title rule.

tokens.name: stroke-box
tokens.usage: Machines, the disk, record cards, the pipe.

tokens.name: stroke-card
tokens.usage: Cards, the barrier line, flow lines.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: The blue rule under the header.

tokens.name: stroke-deck
tokens.usage: The cream border around the studio deck.

size.note: Fixed dimensions of the frame and its parts at k = 1.

tokens.name: frame-width
tokens.usage: Reference width of the frame; k = actual width / 470.

tokens.name: frame-height
tokens.usage: Reference height (ratio 0.5629, about 9:16). The frame is min(95vh, 835px) tall.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: The header bar.

tokens.name: deck-height
tokens.usage: The docked deck during a scene.

tokens.name: deck-height-beat
tokens.usage: The deck expanded for a beat.

tokens.name: pill-height
tokens.usage: Standard pill; 15–16px for key pills, 21px on the closing card.

tokens.name: scrub-height
tokens.usage: The scrubber track area.

tokens.name: cursor-width
tokens.usage: The header's blinking cursor block.

tokens.name: cursor-height
tokens.usage: The header's blinking cursor block.

shadow.note: Warm ink shadows that fall straight down. Focus rings are additions.

tokens.name: shadow-frame
tokens.usage: The frame on the stage.

tokens.name: shadow-deck
tokens.usage: The studio deck.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and the closing card.

tokens.name: shadow-terminal
tokens.usage: The terminal bar.

tokens.name: shadow-pill
tokens.usage: Filled pills (outline pills have none).

tokens.name: shadow-record
tokens.usage: Record cards.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on cream and paper: a 2px cream gap, then 2px of blue.

tokens.name: focus-ring-deck
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on the deck: a 2px ink gap, then 2px of amber.
